main_text.p: regem Philippum II. ad cælum extolle-bant, qvi ipsorum ritus, ceremonias, im-piumqve Thalmud suis impensis excusfit; ad qvod adducebant Cantica, Threnos, Ecclesiastem, Job & 53. Isaiæ. In tanta animorum pernitie & clade divino con-filio factum putavi, omnia exemplaria istius Paraphrasis Chaldaicæ, qvam ipsi pro vulgata ad textus Hebræi expositio-nem habere intendunt, evolvere; animumqve & totum conatum illius expo-sitioni intendere: Inter præcipua & ex-actissima mihi occurrit exemplar Syria-ce conscriptum, qvod erat apud Joan-nem Baptistam Raimundum traditum à Greg. XIII. ad eum inter alia qvamplu-rima exemplaria ab oriente missa, ut te-stantur testimonia authentica, qvæ penes me sunt; exemplaria ista sunt integra & incorrupta, qvæ mala manus Rabbinica Characteris ignara vitiare non potuit, & cum conservantur in primo illo nitore, mirum in modum Christianæ Reli-gioni favent; armaqve fortia ad Rabbi-norum Hæreticorumqve acies revelan-das

page.notes: Printed "exemplaria" after "omnia" has a speck between the words, not a printed mark. "53." after "Job &" is read as printed, with the first figure uncertain. The catchword "das" repeats the start of the next page's word "revelandas".
